# A REAL capture: the user's Devil's Canyon (i5-4690K) in lounge-box, which the
# user pointed out can PARTIALLY decode VP9. Its driver offers only MPEG2,
# H.264, VC1 and JPEG for decoding -- the newer codecs do not appear even
# though the silicon can do some of that work on the GPU.
#
# Auto must therefore ask for H.264 here, which is both the fully hardware path
# and what the user asked for. Taken with: ssh lounge-box vainfo
